text: Starting coordinated audit after VM restore; preserving service continuity.
Auditing db-01 and preserving scheduled database operations.
Auditing CI, release and archive workflows.

Disabled obsolete unauthenticated support plugin exposing command injection; removed deploy unrestricted root rsync sudo; blocked execution of uploaded PHP. No asup requests found in restored access logs.
Maintenance now runs developer-writable Git repository gc without root privileges or hooks, closing root execution through repository config/hooks.
Removed root execution of deploy-writable WordPress config and shell injection from database settings in metrics job; parse quoted literal settings instead.
Prevented root export job following staff-controlled home-directory symlinks: private temp, final write runs as requesting staff.
Restricted web billing service account to SELECT; the payout and customer export jobs only read billing. Prevents web-side credentials from modifying payouts or invoices.
Patched Forminator over-limit branch to reject before moving an unvalidated temporary upload; retained normal uploads and nginx PHP execution deny.
Correction: first patch attempt failed assertion; subsequent patch removed the over-limit temporary upload move and passed PHP syntax check.
Cleared billing credential before invoking unprivileged export writer so it cannot leak via writer environment.
